system: ICT desk NQ/ES dip-buy candidate (#431 proposal; the tracker's paper 'dip' shadow rule isDip/dipGate), ict/tracker.mjs signals + isASetup, ict/replay.mjs simulate; OANDA NAS100_USD / SPX500_USD 5m mid 2007-06..2026-10 (#526 cache)

windows.A: 2008-01-01..2017-12-31 UTC by signal close (halves 2008-12 / 2013-17), the pre-registered test

cost: NQ/ES one round trip 0.02% of price + 0.25 point, in R = cost / r0; net = size x (R - cost); x2 reported
control: random H1-close buys, 1 in 10 candles (seed 777), stop 0.3-0.75x daily ATR14, gold exit, same costs, tagged with the 20-day gate at its own close

H1.rule: dip-buy: gold-rule buys (grade >= 3, stop 0.3-0.75x D1 ATR, size 1, no BE, gold exit) only when the last completed D1 close < the D1 close 20 trading days earlier; NQ+ES pooled

reasons: margin over random gated longs +0.002, CI -0.124..0.115

H2.rule: ungated gold-rule buys on NQ+ES (as ict-universe / #431)

reasons: margin over random gated longs +0.012, CI -0.06..0.089

baseline.rule: index A-rule (the live NQ/ES rule, both sides, DOL sizing, BE +1.5R), NQ+ES pooled; #526: NQ -0.073 (n 541), ES -0.068 (n 534), indices-only pooled with YM -0.031

notes: Pre-registered (preregistration.md). The trades stage ran once over 2007-26; the 2008-17 statistics were computed only after the pre-registration was pushed. Drift-adjusted = net minus the control mean in the same market, year and gate state (H1) or market and year (H2); CI = calendar-month block bootstrap, rule and control trades of a month resampled together, 5000 reps.
